clauses.notes: Souvenir advertisement: clearly disallowed u/s 37(2B). 80GGB would treat it as a contribution, but 115BAA companies cannot claim Chapter VI-A deductions. Club: the Supreme Court (United Glass, 2012) allowed corporate club subscriptions for business use, so only the entrance fee or personal portion is disallowable — kept out of the impact pending the CA's call. GST: if the Rs. 45,000 is a late fee under s.47 CGST (compensatory) rather than a penalty, it is allowable — check the challan. CSR: s.135 does not apply (turnover < 1,000 cr, profit < 5 cr), so Explanation 2 arguably does not bite; deductibility then depends on business purpose — conservative disallowance shown. Motor car: GST note calls the car 'personal/mixed use'; without a log book the personal share cannot be measured.
